lane:
تموز

تَمُّوزُ [sometimes written تَمُوزُ, without tesh-deed,] _The_ [_Syrian_] _month_ [_sacred,_ in ancient times, _to the god of that name,_ (mentioned in Ezek. viii. 14,) _corresponding to July, O. S.,_] _after_ حَزِيرانُ. (S in art. حزر.)
